scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run migration:run -w backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.sync: git switch main && git pull && node scripts/install-if-changed.mjs && npm run db:up && npm run migration:run -w backend
scripts.sync:branch: git fetch origin && git merge --no-commit origin/main && node scripts/install-if-changed.mjs && npm run db:up && npm run migration:run -w backend
